create or alter procedure [dbo].[GetSiteNavigation] ( @ResourceID int = 0 ) AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS #tempNoReadAssetTypes;
SELECT * INTO #tempNoReadAssetTypes FROM [dbo].[AssetTypesUserCantRead](@ResourceID);
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, NULL AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Monitor' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, NULL AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Home' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 UNION ALL
SELECT n.name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( select T.name, AUrl.[Url] as [url], 0 as feature, dbo.ArtifactNgSiteNavigation(T.ObjectID) as items from AssetType T cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl left join SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = 'ArtifactType' WHERE not exists ( select IT.SubjectID from IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on IT.Object = T.Object and IT.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.Type = 3 ) and not exists (select 1 from #tempNoReadAssetTypes nr where nr.AssetTypeId = T.ID) and v.ObjectID is null and T.Object = 'ArtifactType' and T.[Class] = 1 Order By T.name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Business' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( select T.name, AUrl.[Url] as [url], 0 as feature, dbo.ArtifactNgSiteNavigation(T.ObjectID) as items from AssetType T cross apply [dbo].[GetAssetTypeUrlById](T.ID) AUrl left join SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = 'ArtifactType' WHERE not exists ( select IT.SubjectID from IntersectType IT inner join [Predicate] P on IT.Object = T.Object and IT.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and P.ID = IT.PredicateID and P.Type = 3 ) and not exists (select 1 from #tempNoReadAssetTypes nr where nr.AssetTypeId = T.ID) and v.ObjectID is null and T.Object = 'ArtifactType' and T.[Class] = 8 Order By T.name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Technical' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT name, url, 0 as feature, null as items FROM ( SELECT TOP 1000 T.ObjectID, T.Name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url FROM AssetType T left join SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = 'TaxonomyType' WHERE v.ObjectID is null and T.Object = 'TaxonomyType' and not exists (select 1 from #tempNoReadAssetTypes nr where nr.AssetTypeId = T.ID) ORDER BY T.Name ) BG FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Models' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT name, url, 0 as feature, null as items FROM ( SELECT TOP 1000 T.ObjectID, T.name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url FROM AssetType T left join SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = T.ObjectID and v.Object = 'PolicyType' WHERE v.ObjectID is null and T.Object = 'PolicyType' and not exists (select 1 from #tempNoReadAssetTypes nr where nr.AssetTypeId = T.ID) ORDER BY T.name ) BG FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Policy' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, null AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Reference' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 4 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT 'People' AS name, 'community/groups' AS url, 0 as feature, NULL AS Items FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Community' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1 UNION ALL SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT RT.name, dbo.GenerateAssetTypeUrl(T.ID) As url, 0 as feature, null AS items FROM RuleType RT inner join AssetType T on T.Object = 'RuleType' and T.ObjectID = RT.ID LEFT JOIN SiteNav v on v.ObjectID = RT.ID and v.Object ='RuleType' WHERE v.ObjectID IS NULL Order By RT.name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Data Quality' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL SELECT n.Name as MenuID, n.SortOrder, 0 as Feature, n.Icon as Icon, n.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, n.Title as Title, ( SELECT DISTINCT R.name, CONCAT('dashboard/',R.ID) As url, 0 as feature, null AS items FROM Report R left join ReportResponsibility rs on rs.ReportID = R.ID left join ResponsibilityDetail rd on rd.ResponsibilityTypeID = rs.ResponsibilityTypeID and @ResourceID = rd.ResourceID WHERE (rs.ResponsibilityTypeID is not null and rd.ResourceID = @ResourceID) or (rd.ResourceID is null and rs.ResponsibilityTypeID is null) AND R.ReportType != 'legacy' Order By R.name FOR XML PATH('nav'), TYPE ) AS Items FROM SiteNav n WHERE n.Name = '#Dashboards' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(n.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT '~' + Name AS MenuID, s.SortOrder, 0 AS Feature, s.Icon as Icon, s.ImageIconUrl as ImageIconUrl, s.Title as Title, dbo.CustomSiteNavigation(ID) AS Items from SiteNav s where ParentID IS NULL and Name not like '#%' AND dbo.HasSiteNavPermission(s.ID, @ResourceID) = 1
order by sortorder END
